ko.title: 주식과 중간선거: 선거일 이후 시장에 대해 역사가 말해주는 것과 그렇지 않은 것

segments.src: Every two years, a familiar line shows up in market commentary: stocks tend to rally after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: 2년마다 시장 논평에서 익숙한 문구가 등장합니다. 바로 중간선거 이후 주식이 상승하는 경향이 있다는 것입니다.

segments.src: There is some truth in it.
segments.tr: 여기에는 어느 정도 진실이 담겨 있습니다.

segments.src: But the pattern is a loose tendency, not a rule, and it can be easy to overstate.
segments.tr: 하지만 이 패턴은 규칙이 아닌 느슨한 경향일 뿐이며, 과장하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: This article looks at what past cycles show, where the pattern comes from, and why interest rates and corporate earnings usually matter more than the ballot box.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 과거의 주기가 무엇을 보여주는지, 이 패턴이 어디에서 유래했는지, 그리고 왜 금리와 기업 실적이 투표함보다 보통 더 중요한지를 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: ## What the historical pattern says
segments.tr: ## 역사적 패턴이 말하는 것

segments.src: Market analysts have studied the four-year presidential cycle for decades.
segments.tr: 시장 분석가들은 수십 년 동안 4년 대통령 임기 주기를 연구해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Their most widely repeated finding is that the midterm year (the second year of a presidential term) has often been the weakest stretch of the cycle for U.S.
segments.tr: 가장 널리 반복되는 연구 결과는 중간선거가 있는 해(대통령 임기 2년 차)가 미국 주식 시장에서

segments.src: stocks.
segments.tr: 종종 가장 약세를 보이는 구간이었다는 것입니다.

segments.src: Intra-year pullbacks have been common, and several midterm years have seen sizable declines at some point.
segments.tr: 연중 조정은 흔한 일이었으며, 여러 중간선거 해에는 특정 시점에 상당한 하락을 겪기도 했습니다.

segments.src: The stretch that follows has often looked better.
segments.tr: 그 이후의 기간은 종종 더 나은 모습을 보였습니다.

segments.src: In many past cycles, the S&P 500 was higher 6 and 12 months after Election Day, and the period from the fourth quarter of a midterm year through the following year has frequently been among the stronger windows in the cycle.
segments.tr: 과거의 많은 주기에서 S&P 500 지수는 선거일 6개월 및 12개월 후에 더 높았으며, 중간선거 해의 4분기부터 이듬해까지의 기간은 종종 주기 내에서 가장 강세를 보인 구간 중 하나였습니다.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by source, by start date and by which years are included, so it is best to treat any single statistic with caution.
segments.tr: 정확한 수치는 출처, 시작 날짜, 포함된 연도에 따라 다르므로 단일 통계를 해석할 때는 주의해야 합니다.

segments.src: Some examples show how mixed the record is:
segments.tr: 기록이 얼마나 혼조세를 보이는지 보여주는 몇 가지 사례는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **2002:** Stocks bottomed in October, shortly before the midterms, after a prolonged bear market. A recovery followed in 2003.
segments.tr: - **2002년:** 주식은 장기적인 약세장 끝에 중간선거 직전인 10월에 바닥을 쳤습니다. 2003년에 회복세가 이어졌습니다.

segments.src: - **2010:** Markets climbed through the fall and into 2011, helped by Federal Reserve support after the financial crisis.
segments.tr: - **2010년:** 금융 위기 이후 연방준비제도(Fed)의 지원에 힘입어 시장은 가을부터 2011년까지 상승했습니다.

segments.src: - **2018:** A sharp late-year selloff ended around Christmas Eve. Stocks rebounded strongly in 2019 as the Fed paused its rate increases.
segments.tr: - **2018년:** 연말의 급격한 매도세가 크리스마스 이브 무렵에 끝났습니다. 연준이 금리 인상을 일시 중단하면서 2019년에 주식은 강하게 반등했습니다.

segments.src: - **2022:** The S&P 500 had a rough year as inflation and rate hikes weighed on valuations. The market bottomed in October, before the election, and recovered in 2023.
segments.tr: - **2022년:** 인플레이션과 금리 인상이 밸류에이션에 부담을 주면서 S&P 500은 힘든 한 해를 보냈습니다. 시장은 선거 전인 10월에 바닥을 찍고 2023년에 회복했습니다.

segments.src: - **1994:** A surprise bond-market rout and a sharp round of Fed rate hikes left stocks largely flat, even though the political shift was dramatic.
segments.tr: - **1994년:** 예상치 못한 채권 시장의 급락과 연준의 급격한 금리 인상으로 인해 정치적 변화가 극적이었음에도 불구하고 주가는 대체로 보합세를 보였습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks
segments.tr: ## "중간선거 이후 랠리"가 보이는 것만큼 인과관계가 적을 수 있는 이유

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.
segments.tr: 달력의 특정 시점에 너무 큰 의미를 부여하는 것에 회의적이어야 할 몇 가지 이유가 있습니다.

segments.src: Uncertainty gets resolved.** Investors dislike not knowing.
segments.tr: 불확실성이 해소됩니다.** 투자자들은 불확실성을 싫어합니다.

segments.src: Once the election is over, one source of unpredictability fades.
segments.tr: 선거가 끝나면 예측 불가능성의 한 가지 원인이 사라집니다.

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: 이는 투자 심리를 끌어올릴 수 있지만, 일회성 안도감일 뿐 지속적인 수익의 원동력은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: 교착 상태가 명확하게 강세장이나 약세장을 의미하지는 않습니다.** 분열된 정부가 입법이 거의 통과되지 않기 때문에 주식에 좋다는 흔한 주장이 있습니다.

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: 증거는 엇갈립니다.

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: 시장은 다양한 정당 통제 조합 하에서 좋은 성과를 내기도 하고 나쁜 성과를 내기도 했으며, 결과는 경제에서 다른 어떤 일이 일어나고 있었는지에 크게 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: 표본이 작습니다.** 현대 시대에 중간선거는 10여 차례 정도밖에 없었습니다.

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: 특히 각 기간마다 고유한 경기 침체, 금리 주기, 충격이 있었기 때문에 실제 효과와 우연을 구분하기에는 관측치가 너무 적습니다.

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: 타이밍이 다른 요인들과 겹칩니다.** 중간선거 해는 종종 연준의 긴축 주기 후반부, 경기 둔화, 또는 시장 조정과 겹칩니다.

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: 조정이 끝나고 주가가 회복될 때, 금리나 실적 기대치의 변화가 실제 역할을 했을 수 있음에도 불구하고 선거 덕분이라고 생각하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## 더 중요한 것: 금리와 실적

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: 장기적으로 주가는 두 가지 광범위한 힘을 따릅니다. 기업이 얼마나 버는지, 그리고 투자자가 그 수익을 어떻게 평가하는지입니다.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **금리.** 금리가 높으면 미래 수익의 현재 가치가 낮아지고 기업과 가계의 차입 비용이 증가합니다. 연준이 금리 인상을 멈추거나 인하하기 시작하면 밸류에이션은 종종 안도감을 얻습니다. 중간선거 이후 더 나은 성과를 보인 여러 구간은 금리 전망의 변화와 일치했습니다.

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.
segments.tr: - **기업 실적.** 주식이 계속 상승하려면 궁극적으로 이익 성장이 필요합니다. 매출 추세, 마진, 기업 경영진의 향후 가이던스가 일반적으로 의회를 누가 장악하느냐보다 시장의 방향을 더 많이 좌우합니다.

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.
segments.tr: - **인플레이션과 성장.** 인플레이션은 금리와 기업 비용 모두에 영향을 미치며, 경제 성장은 수요를 형성합니다. 이 둘이 합쳐져 실적의 배경을 설정합니다.

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.
segments.tr: - **밸류에이션과 시작점.** 시장이 어디에서 시작하는지가 중요합니다. 침체된 수준에서의 랠리는 가격이 이미 높은 상태에서 시작하는 랠리와는 다릅니다.

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.
segments.tr: 정책은 세금, 관세, 규제, 정부 지출 등을 통해 이러한 요소에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: But the effect usually plays out over years and depends on laws that actually pass, which is far from certain after any election.
segments.tr: 하지만 그 효과는 보통 수년에 걸쳐 나타나며 실제로 통과되는 법안에 달려 있는데, 이는 선거 이후에도 불확실한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## 투자자가 고려해야 할 점

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: 역사로부터 몇 가지 실질적인 교훈을 얻을 수 있지만, 그중 어떤 것도 예측은 아닙니다:

segments.src: - **Treat seasonal patterns as context, not a signal.** A historical tendency can be interesting, but it is a weak basis for making large changes to a portfolio.
segments.tr: - **계절적 패턴을 신호가 아닌 맥락으로 대하십시오.** 역사적 경향은 흥미로울 수 있지만, 포트폴리오에 큰 변화를 주기 위한 근거로는 약합니다.

segments.src: - **Watch the fundamentals.** The Fed's path, inflation data, and quarterly earnings reports are more direct clues to where markets may head.
segments.tr: - **펀더멘털을 주시하십시오.** 연준의 경로, 인플레이션 데이터, 분기별 실적 보고서는 시장이 어디로 향할지에 대한 더 직접적인 단서입니다.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Short-term moves around elections can be noisy and reverse quickly.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인에 반응하지 마십시오.** 선거 전후의 단기적인 움직임은 소음이 많고 빠르게 반전될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Match decisions to your goals.** Time horizon, diversification and risk tolerance usually matter more than election timing.
segments.tr: - **결정을 목표에 맞추십시오.** 투자 기간, 다각화, 위험 감수 성향은 일반적으로 선거 타이밍보다 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The idea of a post-midterm rally is not baseless.
segments.tr: 중간선거 이후 랠리라는 아이디어가 근거가 없는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Many past cycles saw stocks do well in the year after Election Day.
segments.tr: 과거의 많은 주기에서 선거일 이후 1년 동안 주식 시장은 좋은 성과를 거두었습니다.

segments.src: Still, the pattern has exceptions, the sample is small, and the causes are hard to pin on politics alone.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 이 패턴에는 예외가 있고, 표본은 작으며, 원인을 정치만으로 돌리기는 어렵습니다.

segments.src: For investors, the more reliable questions are about the trajectory of interest rates and the health of corporate profits.
segments.tr: 투자자에게 더 신뢰할 수 있는 질문은 금리의 궤적과 기업 이익의 건전성에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: The election may shape the mood, but those two factors have usually shaped the results.
segments.tr: 선거가 분위기를 형성할 수는 있지만, 보통 그 두 가지 요소가 결과를 결정해 왔습니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 작성되었으며 투자, 세금 또는 법률 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Past performance does not guarantee future results.
segments.tr: 과거의 성과가 미래의 결과를 보장하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Consider consulting a qualified financial professional before making investment decisions.*
segments.tr: 투자 결정을 내리기 전에 자격을 갖춘 재무 전문가와 상담하십시오.*

segments.tr: 一旦选举结束，一个不可预测性的来源就消退了。

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: 这可以提振情绪，但这是一次性的释怀，而不是持久的回报引擎。

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: 僵局并不明确构成利好或利空。** 一种常见的观点是，分裂的政府利好股市，因为几乎没有法案能通过。

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: 证据毁誉参半。

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: 在党派控制权的多种组合下，市场既有良好表现也有糟糕表现，结果在很大程度上取决于当时经济中发生的其他情况。

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: 样本太小。** 现代历史上大约只有十几次中期选举。

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: 由于观测值太少，无法将真实效果与巧合区分开来，尤其是当每个时期都有其自身的衰退、利率周期或冲击时。

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: 时间线与其他因素重叠。** 中期选举年往往与美联储紧缩周期的后期、经济放缓或市场回调重合。

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: 当回调结束、股市复苏时，人们很容易归功于选举，而实际上可能是利率或盈利预期的转变发挥了作用。

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## 往往更重要的因素：利率与盈利

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: 从长期来看，股票价格受两大主导力量影响：企业的盈利能力，以及投资者如何对这些盈利进行估值。

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **利率。** 较高的利率折算为今天的价值时会降低未来利润的价值，并提高企业和家庭的借贷成本。当美联储停止加息或开始降息时，估值通常会得到喘息。中期选举后几个表现较好的时期，恰好与利率前景的变化相吻合。

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.
segments.tr: - **企业盈利。** 股市归根结底需要利润增长来维持上涨。营收趋势、利润率和企业管理层的业绩指引，通常比谁控制国会更能主导市场的走向。

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.
segments.tr: - **通胀与增长。** 通胀既影响利率也影响企业成本，而经济增长塑造了需求。它们共同构成了盈利的大背景。

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.
segments.tr: - **估值与起点。** 市场的起点很重要。从低迷水平展开的反弹，不同于在价格已经高企时开始的反弹。

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.
segments.tr: 政策可以通过税收、关税、监管和政府支出等方式影响这些因素。

segments.src: But the effect usually plays out over years and depends on laws that actually pass, which is far from certain after any election.
segments.tr: 但这种效应通常需要数年时间才能显现，且取决于最终实际通过的法律，这在任何选举后都是充满不确定性的。

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## 投资者可以如何思考

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: 从历史中可以得出以下几点实用要领，无一构成预测：

segments.src: - **Treat seasonal patterns as context, not a signal.** A historical tendency can be interesting, but it is a weak basis for making large changes to a portfolio.
segments.tr: - **将季节性模式视为背景，而非信号。** 历史趋势可能很有趣，但作为对投资组合做出重大调整的依据却很脆弱。

segments.src: - **Watch the fundamentals.** The Fed's path, inflation data, and quarterly earnings reports are more direct clues to where markets may head.
segments.tr: - **关注基本面。** 美联储的路径、通胀数据和季度财报，是判断市场未来走向更直接的线索。

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Short-term moves around elections can be noisy and reverse quickly.
segments.tr: - **避免对头条新闻做出过激反应。** 围绕选举的短期波动可能伴随噪音，且很快就会逆转。

segments.src: - **Match decisions to your goals.** Time horizon, diversification and risk tolerance usually matter more than election timing.
segments.tr: - **让决策与你的目标相匹配。** 投资期限、分散投资和风险承受能力通常比选举时机更重要。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The idea of a post-midterm rally is not baseless.
segments.tr: “中期选举后反弹”的观点并非毫无根据。

segments.src: Many past cycles saw stocks do well in the year after Election Day.
segments.tr: 过去的许多周期都显示，股市在选举日后的一年里表现良好。

segments.src: Still, the pattern has exceptions, the sample is small, and the causes are hard to pin on politics alone.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，这一模式存在例外，样本较小，且原因很难单独归咎于政治。

segments.src: For investors, the more reliable questions are about the trajectory of interest rates and the health of corporate profits.
segments.tr: 对投资者而言，更可靠的问题在于利率的轨迹和企业利润的健康状况。

segments.src: The election may shape the mood, but those two factors have usually shaped the results.
segments.tr: 选举可能会影响情绪，但这两个因素通常决定了最终的结果。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成投资、税务或法律建议。

segments.tr: 过往业绩不保证未来结果。

segments.tr: 在做出投资决策前，请考虑咨询有资质的金融专业人士。*

hi.title: स्टॉक्स और मध्यावधि चुनाव: चुनाव के दिन के बाद बाजारों के बारे में इतिहास क्या कहता है, और क्या नहीं

segments.src: Every two years, a familiar line shows up in market commentary: stocks tend to rally after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: हर दो साल में, बाजार की टिप्पणियों में एक जाना-पहचाना तर्क दिखाई देता है: मध्यावधि (मिडटर्म) चुनावों के बाद शेयरों में तेजी आने की प्रवृत्ति होती है।

segments.src: There is some truth in it.
segments.tr: इसमें कुछ सच्चाई है।

segments.src: But the pattern is a loose tendency, not a rule, and it can be easy to overstate.
segments.tr: लेकिन यह पैटर्न एक ढीली प्रवृत्ति है, कोई नियम नहीं, और इसे बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर पेश करना आसान हो सकता है।

segments.src: This article looks at what past cycles show, where the pattern comes from, and why interest rates and corporate earnings usually matter more than the ballot box.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि पिछले चक्र क्या दिखाते हैं, यह पैटर्न कहाँ से आता है, और ब्याज दरें और कॉर्पोरेट आय आमतौर पर मतदान के दिन से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण क्यों होती हैं।

segments.src: ## What the historical pattern says
segments.tr: ## ऐतिहासिक पैटर्न क्या कहता है

segments.src: Market analysts have studied the four-year presidential cycle for decades.
segments.tr: बाजार विश्लेषकों ने दशकों से चार साल के राष्ट्रपति चक्र का अध्ययन किया है।

segments.src: Their most widely repeated finding is that the midterm year (the second year of a presidential term) has often been the weakest stretch of the cycle for U.S.
segments.tr: उनका सबसे व्यापक रूप से दोहराया जाने वाला निष्कर्ष यह है कि मध्यावधि वर्ष (राष्ट्रपति पद के कार्यकाल का दूसरा वर्ष) अमेरिकी

segments.src: stocks.
segments.tr: शेयरों के लिए इस चक्र की सबसे कमजोर अवधि रही है।

segments.src: Intra-year pullbacks have been common, and several midterm years have seen sizable declines at some point.
segments.tr: वर्ष के भीतर गिरावट (Intra-year pullbacks) आम रही है, और कई मध्यावधि वर्षों में किसी न किसी मोड़ पर बड़ी गिरावट देखी गई है।

segments.src: The stretch that follows has often looked better.
segments.tr: इसके बाद आने वाला समय अक्सर बेहतर दिखता है।

segments.src: In many past cycles, the S&P 500 was higher 6 and 12 months after Election Day, and the period from the fourth quarter of a midterm year through the following year has frequently been among the stronger windows in the cycle.
segments.tr: अतीत के कई चक्रों में, S&P 500 चुनाव के दिन से 6 और 12 महीने बाद अधिक था, और मध्यावधि वर्ष की चौथी तिमाही से अगले वर्ष तक की अवधि अक्सर इस चक्र की सबसे मजबूत अवधियों में से एक रही है।

segments.src: Exact figures vary by source, by start date and by which years are included, so it is best to treat any single statistic with caution.
segments.tr: सटीक आंकड़े स्रोत, शुरुआत की तारीख और किन वर्षों को शामिल किया गया है, इसके आधार पर भिन्न होते हैं, इसलिए किसी भी एकल आंकड़े को सावधानी के साथ देखना सबसे अच्छा है।

segments.src: Some examples show how mixed the record is:
segments.tr: कुछ उदाहरण बताते हैं कि रिकॉर्ड कितना मिला-जुला रहा है:

segments.src: - **2002:** Stocks bottomed in October, shortly before the midterms, after a prolonged bear market. A recovery followed in 2003.
segments.tr: - **2002:** लंबे समय तक चले बियर मार्केट के बाद, मध्यावधि चुनावों से ठीक पहले, अक्टूबर में शेयर अपने निचले स्तर पर पहुंच गए थे। 2003 में एक रिकवरी देखी गई।

segments.src: - **2010:** Markets climbed through the fall and into 2011, helped by Federal Reserve support after the financial crisis.
segments.tr: - **2010:** वित्तीय संकट के बाद फेडरल रिजर्व के समर्थन से मदद पाकर, बाजार पतझड़ के दौरान और 2011 तक चढ़ते रहे।

segments.src: - **2018:** A sharp late-year selloff ended around Christmas Eve. Stocks rebounded strongly in 2019 as the Fed paused its rate increases.
segments.tr: - **2018:** वर्ष के अंत में तेज बिकवाली क्रिसमस की पूर्व संध्या के आसपास समाप्त हुई। 2019 में शेयर बाजारों में जोरदार उछाल आया, क्योंकि फेड ने अपनी दरों में बढ़ोतरी रोक दी।

segments.src: - **2022:** The S&P 500 had a rough year as inflation and rate hikes weighed on valuations. The market bottomed in October, before the election, and recovered in 2023.
segments.tr: - **2022:** S&P 500 के लिए यह साल मुश्किल भरा रहा क्योंकि मुद्रास्फीति और दर वृद्धि ने वैल्यूएशन को प्रभावित किया। चुनाव से पहले, अक्टूबर में बाजार निचले स्तर पर पहुंचा और 2023 में उबर गया।

segments.src: - **1994:** A surprise bond-market rout and a sharp round of Fed rate hikes left stocks largely flat, even though the political shift was dramatic.
segments.tr: - **1994:** बांड-बाजार में एक अप्रत्याशित गिरावट और फेड की दर वृद्धि के एक कड़े दौर ने शेयरों को काफी हद तक सपाट रखा, भले ही राजनीतिक बदलाव नाटकीय था।

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks
segments.tr: ## "मध्यावधि के बाद की तेजी" उतनी कारण-आधारित (causal) क्यों नहीं हो सकती जितनी यह दिखती है

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.
segments.tr: कैलेंडर पर बहुत अधिक ध्यान देने को लेकर संशयवादी होने के कुछ कारण हैं।

segments.src: Uncertainty gets resolved.** Investors dislike not knowing.
segments.tr: अनिश्चितता का समाधान हो जाता है।** निवेशक अनिश्चितता को पसंद नहीं करते।

segments.src: Once the election is over, one source of unpredictability fades.
segments.tr: एक बार चुनाव खत्म हो जाने पर, अप्रत्याशितता का एक स्रोत फीका पड़ जाता है।

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: यह धारणा को बढ़ा सकता है, लेकिन यह एक बार मिलने वाली राहत है, रिटर्न के लिए कोई स्थायी इंजन नहीं।

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: गतिरोध (Gridlock) स्पष्ट रूप से तेजी या मंदी वाला नहीं है।** एक आम दावा यह है कि विभाजित सरकार शेयरों के लिए अच्छी होती है क्योंकि बहुत कम कानून पारित होते हैं।

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: इसके सबूत मिले-जुले हैं।

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: पार्टी नियंत्रण के कई संयोजनों के तहत बाजारों ने अच्छा और बुरा दोनों प्रदर्शन किया है, और परिणाम काफी हद तक इस बात पर निर्भर करते हैं कि अर्थव्यवस्था में उस समय और क्या हो रहा था।

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: सैंपल का आकार छोटा है।** आधुनिक युग में केवल एक दर्जन या उससे कुछ ही अधिक मध्यावधि चुनाव हुए हैं।

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: संयोग से किसी वास्तविक प्रभाव को अलग करने के लिए यह बहुत कम अवलोकन (observations) हैं, खासकर तब जब प्रत्येक अवधि की अपनी मंदी, दर चक्र या झटका भी था।

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: समय अन्य चीजों के साथ ओवरलैप करता है।** मध्यावधि वर्ष अक्सर फेड के कड़े चक्र के अंतिम चरण, धीमी होती अर्थव्यवस्था, या बाजार में सुधार (करैक्शन) के साथ मेल खाते हैं।

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: जब सुधार समाप्त होता है और शेयर उबरते हैं, तो इसका श्रेय चुनाव को देने का मन करता है, जबकि दरों या आय की उम्मीदों में बदलाव ने शायद वह काम किया हो।

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## क्या चीजें अधिक मायने रखती हैं: दरें और आय

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: लंबी अवधि में, शेयरों की कीमतें दो व्यापक ताकतों का पालन करती हैं: कंपनियां कितना कमाती हैं, और निवेशक उन आय को कैसे महत्व देते हैं।

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **ब्याज दरें।** उच्च दरें भविष्य के मुनाफे को आज के संदर्भ में कम मूल्यवान बनाती हैं और कंपनियों और परिवारों के लिए उधार लेने की लागत बढ़ाती हैं। जब फेड दरों को बढ़ाना बंद कर देता है, या उन्हें काटना शुरू कर देता है, तो वैल्यूएशन को अक्सर राहत मिलती है। मध्यावधि के बाद के कई बेहतर दौर दरों के परिदृश्य में बदलाव के साथ संरेखित हुए हैं।

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.

es.title: Las acciones y las elecciones de mitad de mandato: lo que dice la historia sobre los mercados después del día de las elecciones y lo que no dice

segments.src: Every two years, a familiar line shows up in market commentary: stocks tend to rally after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Cada dos años, aparece una frase familiar en los comentarios del mercado: las acciones tienden a repuntar después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato.

segments.src: There is some truth in it.
segments.tr: Hay algo de verdad en ello.

segments.src: But the pattern is a loose tendency, not a rule, and it can be easy to overstate.
segments.tr: Pero el patrón es una tendencia vaga, no una regla, y puede ser fácil exagerarlo.

segments.src: This article looks at what past cycles show, where the pattern comes from, and why interest rates and corporate earnings usually matter more than the ballot box.
segments.tr: Este artículo analiza lo que muestran los ciclos pasados, de dónde proviene el patrón y por qué las tasas de interés y las ganancias corporativas suelen importar más que las urnas.

segments.src: ## What the historical pattern says
segments.tr: ## Lo que dice el patrón histórico

segments.src: Market analysts have studied the four-year presidential cycle for decades.
segments.tr: Los analistas de mercado han estudiado el ciclo presidencial de cuatro años durante décadas.

segments.src: Their most widely repeated finding is that the midterm year (the second year of a presidential term) has often been the weakest stretch of the cycle for U.S.
segments.tr: Su hallazgo más repetido es que el año de mitad de mandato (el segundo año de un mandato presidencial) a menudo ha sido el tramo más débil del ciclo para las acciones de EE.

segments.src: stocks.
segments.tr: UU.

segments.src: Intra-year pullbacks have been common, and several midterm years have seen sizable declines at some point.
segments.tr: Los retrocesos dentro del año han sido comunes, y varios años de mitad de mandato han visto caídas considerables en algún momento.

segments.src: The stretch that follows has often looked better.
segments.tr: El tramo que sigue a menudo se ha visto mejor.

segments.src: In many past cycles, the S&P 500 was higher 6 and 12 months after Election Day, and the period from the fourth quarter of a midterm year through the following year has frequently been among the stronger windows in the cycle.
segments.tr: En muchos ciclos pasados, el S&P 500 estuvo más alto 6 y 12 meses después del día de las elecciones, y el período desde el cuarto trimestre de un año de mitad de mandato hasta el año siguiente ha sido frecuentemente una de las ventanas más fuertes del ciclo.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by source, by start date and by which years are included, so it is best to treat any single statistic with caution.
segments.tr: Las cifras exactas varían según la fuente, la fecha de inicio y qué años se incluyen, por lo que es mejor tratar cualquier estadística individual con precaución.

segments.src: Some examples show how mixed the record is:
segments.tr: Algunos ejemplos muestran cuán mixto es el registro:

segments.src: - **2002:** Stocks bottomed in October, shortly before the midterms, after a prolonged bear market. A recovery followed in 2003.
segments.tr: - **2002:** Las acciones tocaron fondo en octubre, poco antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato, después de un mercado bajista prolongado. Siguió una recuperación en 2003.

segments.src: - **2010:** Markets climbed through the fall and into 2011, helped by Federal Reserve support after the financial crisis.
segments.tr: - **2010:** Los mercados subieron durante el otoño y hasta 2011, ayudados por el apoyo de la Reserva Federal después de la crisis financiera.

segments.src: - **2018:** A sharp late-year selloff ended around Christmas Eve. Stocks rebounded strongly in 2019 as the Fed paused its rate increases.
segments.tr: - **2018:** Una fuerte venta masiva a finales de año terminó alrededor de la víspera de Navidad. Las acciones repuntaron fuertemente en 2019 a medida que la Fed pausó sus aumentos de tasas.

segments.src: - **2022:** The S&P 500 had a rough year as inflation and rate hikes weighed on valuations. The market bottomed in October, before the election, and recovered in 2023.
segments.tr: - **2022:** El S&P 500 tuvo un año difícil ya que la inflación y las alzas de tasas pesaron sobre las valoraciones. El mercado tocó fondo en octubre, antes de las elecciones, y se recuperó en 2023.

segments.src: - **1994:** A surprise bond-market rout and a sharp round of Fed rate hikes left stocks largely flat, even though the political shift was dramatic.
segments.tr: - **1994:** Una sorpresiva derrota en el mercado de bonos y una fuerte ronda de alzas de tasas de la Fed dejaron a las acciones prácticamente planas, a pesar de que el cambio político fue dramático.

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks
segments.tr: ## Por qué el "repunte posterior a las elecciones de mitad de mandato" puede ser menos causal de lo que parece

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.
segments.tr: Hay algunas razones para ser escéptico sobre dar demasiada importancia al calendario.

segments.src: Uncertainty gets resolved.** Investors dislike not knowing.
segments.tr: La incertidumbre se resuelve.** A los inversores no les gusta no saber.

segments.src: Once the election is over, one source of unpredictability fades.
segments.tr: Una vez que terminan las elecciones, una fuente de imprevisibilidad desaparece.

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: Eso puede elevar el sentimiento, pero es un alivio único, no un motor duradero para los rendimientos.

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: El estancamiento no es claramente alcista ni bajista.** Una afirmación común es que un gobierno dividido es bueno para las acciones porque se aprueba poca legislación.

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: La evidencia es mixta.

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: A los mercados les ha ido bien y mal bajo muchas combinaciones de control partidista, y los resultados dependen en gran medida de qué más estaba sucediendo en la economía.

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: La muestra es pequeña.** Solo ha habido alrededor de una docena de elecciones de mitad de mandato en la era moderna.

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: Eso es muy pocas observaciones para separar un efecto real de una coincidencia, especialmente cuando cada período también tuvo su propia recesión, ciclo de tasas o shock.

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: El momento coincide con otras cosas.** Los años de mitad de mandato a menudo coinciden con la etapa final de un ciclo de endurecimiento de la Fed, una economía en desaceleración o una corrección del mercado.

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: Cuando termina la corrección y las acciones se recuperan, es tentador atribuirlo a las elecciones, cuando un cambio en las tasas o en las expectativas de ganancias puede haber hecho el trabajo.

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## Lo que tiende a importar más: tasas y ganancias

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: A largo plazo, los precios de las acciones siguen dos fuerzas generales: cuánto ganan las empresas y cómo los inversores valoran esas ganancias.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **Tasas de interés.** Las tasas más altas hacen que las ganancias futuras valgan menos en términos actuales y aumentan los costos de endeudamiento para las empresas y los hogares. Cuando la Fed deja de subir las tasas, o comienza a reducirlas, las valoraciones a menudo obtienen alivio. Varios de los mejores tramos posteriores a las elecciones de mitad de mandato se alinearon con cambios en las perspectivas de tasas.

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.
segments.tr: - **Ganancias corporativas.** Las acciones finalmente necesitan crecimiento de ganancias para seguir subiendo. Las tendencias de ingresos, los márgenes y la orientación futura de las gerencias de las empresas suelen impulsar la dirección del mercado más que quién controla el Congreso.

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.
segments.tr: - **Inflación y crecimiento.** La inflación afecta tanto a las tasas como a los costos de las empresas, mientras que el crecimiento económico da forma a la demanda. Juntos establecen el telón de fondo para las ganancias.

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.
segments.tr: - **Valoraciones y punto de partida.** Dónde comienza el mercado importa. Un repunte desde un nivel deprimido es diferente de uno que comienza cuando los precios ya son altos.

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.
segments.tr: La política puede influir en estos factores, por ejemplo, a través de impuestos, aranceles, regulación y gasto público.

segments.src: But the effect usually plays out over years and depends on laws that actually pass, which is far from certain after any election.
segments.tr: Pero el efecto generalmente se desarrolla a lo largo de años y depende de las leyes que realmente se aprueban, lo cual está lejos de ser seguro después de cualquier elección.

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## Cómo podrían pensar los inversores al respecto

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: Algunas conclusiones prácticas se derivan de la historia, ninguna de las cuales es una predicción:

segments.src: - **Treat seasonal patterns as context, not a signal.** A historical tendency can be interesting, but it is a weak basis for making large changes to a portfolio.
segments.tr: - **Trate los patrones estacionales como contexto, no como una señal.** Una tendencia histórica puede ser interesante, pero es una base débil para realizar grandes cambios en una cartera.

segments.src: - **Watch the fundamentals.** The Fed's path, inflation data, and quarterly earnings reports are more direct clues to where markets may head.
segments.tr: - **Observe los fundamentos.** El camino de la Fed, los datos de inflación y los informes de ganancias trimestrales son pistas más directas sobre hacia dónde pueden dirigirse los mercados.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Short-term moves around elections can be noisy and reverse quickly.
segments.tr: - **Evite reaccionar a los titulares.** Los movimientos a corto plazo en torno a las elecciones pueden ser ruidosos y revertirse rápidamente.

segments.src: - **Match decisions to your goals.** Time horizon, diversification and risk tolerance usually matter more than election timing.
segments.tr: - **Adapte las decisiones a sus objetivos.** El horizonte temporal, la diversificación y la tolerancia al riesgo suelen importar más que el momento de las elecciones.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The idea of a post-midterm rally is not baseless.
segments.tr: La idea de un repunte posterior a las elecciones de mitad de mandato no carece de fundamento.

segments.src: Many past cycles saw stocks do well in the year after Election Day.
segments.tr: Muchos ciclos pasados vieron a las acciones tener un buen desempeño en el año posterior al día de las elecciones.

segments.src: Still, the pattern has exceptions, the sample is small, and the causes are hard to pin on politics alone.
segments.tr: Aun así, el patrón tiene excepciones, la muestra es pequeña y las causas son difíciles de atribuir solo a la política.

segments.src: For investors, the more reliable questions are about the trajectory of interest rates and the health of corporate profits.
segments.tr: Para los inversores, las preguntas más confiables son sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés y la salud de las ganancias corporativas.

segments.src: The election may shape the mood, but those two factors have usually shaped the results.
segments.tr: Las elecciones pueden moldear el estado de ánimo, pero esos dos factores generalmente han moldeado los resultados.

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks
segments.tr: ## لماذا قد تكون "موجة الصعود بعد الانتخابات النصفية" أقل سببية مما تبدو عليه

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.
segments.tr: هناك بضعة أسباب تجعلنا نشكك في إعطاء أهمية بالغة للتقويم.

segments.src: Uncertainty gets resolved.** Investors dislike not knowing.
segments.tr: زوال حالة عدم اليقين.** لا يحب المستثمرون الغموض.

segments.src: Once the election is over, one source of unpredictability fades.
segments.tr: بمجرد انتهاء الانتخابات، يزول أحد مصادر عدم القدرة على التنبؤ.

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يرفع ذلك معنويات السوق، لكنه ارتياح لمرة واحدة وليس محركًا دائمًا للعوائد.

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: الشلل السياسي ليس صعوديًا أو هبوطيًا بشكل واضح.** من الادعاءات الشائعة أن الحكومة المنقسمة مفيدة للأسهم بسبب قلة التشريعات التي يتم تمريرها.

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: لكن الأدلة متباينة.

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: لقد حققت الأسواق أداءً جيدًا وسيئًا تحت العديد من تشكيلات سيطرة الأحزاب، وتعتمد النتائج بشكل كبير على ما كان يحدث في الاقتصاد بصفة عامة.

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: العينة صغيرة.** لم تكن هناك سوى نحو 12 انتخابات نصفية تقريبًا في العصر الحديث.

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: هذا عدد قليل جدًا من الملاحظات لفصل التأثير الحقيقي عن المصادفة، خاصة عندما كانت كل فترة تتميز أيضًا بركودها الخاص، أو دورة الفائدة، أو صدماتها الخاصة.

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: التوقيت يتداخل مع عوامل أخرى.** غالبًا ما تتزامن سنوات الانتخابات النصفية مع المرحلة المتأخرة من دورة التشديد النقدي للفيدرالي، أو تباطؤ الاقتصاد، أو تصحيح السوق.

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: عندما ينتهي التصحيح وتتعافى الأسهم، يكون من المغري إرجاع الفضل إلى الانتخابات، في حين أن التحول في أسعار الفائدة أو توقعات الأرباح قد يكون هو السبب الحقيقي.

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## ما يميل إلى الأهمية بشكل أكبر: أسعار الفائدة والأرباح

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: على المدى الطويل، تتبع أسعار الأسهم قوتين واسعتين: كم تكسب الشركات، وكيف يقيم المستثمرون تلك الأرباح.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **أسعار الفائدة.** تجعل أسعار الفائدة المرتفعة الأرباح المستقبلية أقل قيمة بمصطلحات اليوم، وتزيد من تكاليف الاقتراض للشركات والأسر. وعندما يتوقف الفيدرالي عن رفع أسعار الفائدة، أو يبدأ في خفضها، غالبًا ما تحصل التقييمات على متنفس. تزامنت العديد من الفترات الأفضل بعد الانتخابات النصفية مع التغيرات في آفاق أسعار الفائدة.

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.
segments.tr: - **أرباح الشركات.** تحتاج الأسهم في النهاية إلى نمو الأرباح لمواصلة الارتفاع. وعادة ما تحدد اتجاهات الإيرادات والهوامش والتوجيهات المستقبلية من إدارات الشركات اتجاه السوق أكثر ممن يسيطر على الكونغرس.

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.
segments.tr: - **التضخم والنمو.** يؤثر التضخم على كل من أسعار الفائدة وتكاليف الشركات، بينما يشكل النمو الاقتصادي الطلب. ومعًا، يحددان الخلفية العامة للأرباح.

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.
segments.tr: - **التقييمات ونقطة الانطلاق.** يعتمد الأمر على نقطة بداية السوق. فالصعود من مستوى منخفض يختلف عن الصعود الذي يبدأ عندما تكون الأسعار مرتفعة بالفعل.

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.
segments.tr: يمكن للسياسات أن تؤثر على هذه العوامل، على سبيل المثال من خلال الضرائب والتعريفات الجمركية والتنظيم والإنفاق الحكومي.

segments.src: But the effect usually plays out over years and depends on laws that actually pass, which is far from certain after any election.
segments.tr: لكن هذا التأثير يتضح عادةً على مدى سنوات ويستند إلى القوانين التي تُمَرَّر بالفعل، وهو أمر بعيد كل البعد عن اليقين بعد أي انتخابات.

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## كيف ينبغي للمستثمرين التفكير في الأمر

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: تتبع ذلك بضعة دروس عملية من التاريخ، ولا يعتبر أي منها توقعًا مستقبليًا:

segments.src: - **Treat seasonal patterns as context, not a signal.** A historical tendency can be interesting, but it is a weak basis for making large changes to a portfolio.
segments.tr: - **تعامل مع الأنماط الموسمية كسياق وليس كإشارة.** قد يكون الميل التاريخي مثيرًا للاهتمام، ولكنه أساس ضعيف لإجراء تغييرات كبيرة في المحفظة الاستثمارية.

segments.src: - **Watch the fundamentals.** The Fed's path, inflation data, and quarterly earnings reports are more direct clues to where markets may head.
segments.tr: - **راقب العوامل الأساسية.** يعتبر مسار الفيدرالي، وبيانات التضخم، وتقارير الأرباح الربع سنوية أدلة أكثر مباشرة على اتجاه الأسواق.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Short-term moves around elections can be noisy and reverse quickly.
segments.tr: - **تجنب التفاعل مع عناوين الأخبار.** يمكن أن تكون التحركات قصيرة المدى حول الانتخابات مليئة بالضوضاء وتنعكس بسرعة.

segments.src: - **Match decisions to your goals.** Time horizon, diversification and risk tolerance usually matter more than election timing.
segments.tr: - **طابق قراراتك مع أهدافك.** عادةً ما تكون الأفق الزمني، والتنوع، وتحمل المخاطر أكثر أهمية من توقيت الانتخابات.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The idea of a post-midterm rally is not baseless.
segments.tr: إن فكرة الارتفاع بعد الانتخابات النصفية ليست بلا أساس.

segments.src: Many past cycles saw stocks do well in the year after Election Day.
segments.tr: شهدت العديد من الدورات السابقة أداءً جيدًا للأسهم في العام الذي تلى يوم الانتخابات.

segments.src: Still, the pattern has exceptions, the sample is small, and the causes are hard to pin on politics alone.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يحتوي هذا النمط على استثناءات، والعينة صغيرة، ومن الصعب إرجاع الأسباب إلى السياسة وحدها.

segments.src: For investors, the more reliable questions are about the trajectory of interest rates and the health of corporate profits.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمستثمرين، فإن الأسئلة الأكثر موثوقية تتعلق بمسار أسعار الفائدة وصحة أرباح الشركات.

segments.src: The election may shape the mood, but those two factors have usually shaped the results.

fr.title: Les actions et les élections de mi-mandat : Ce que l'histoire dit des marchés après le jour du scrutin, et ce qu'elle ne dit pas

segments.src: Every two years, a familiar line shows up in market commentary: stocks tend to rally after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: Tous les deux ans, un refrain familier réapparaît dans les commentaires de marché : les actions ont tendance à rebondir après les élections de mi-mandat.

segments.src: There is some truth in it.
segments.tr: Il y a une part de vérité là-dedans.

segments.src: But the pattern is a loose tendency, not a rule, and it can be easy to overstate.
segments.tr: Mais ce schéma est une tendance vague, pas une règle, et il peut être facile de le surévaluer.

segments.src: This article looks at what past cycles show, where the pattern comes from, and why interest rates and corporate earnings usually matter more than the ballot box.
segments.tr: Cet article examine ce que montrent les cycles passés, d'où provient ce schéma, et pourquoi les taux d'intérêt et les bénéfices des entreprises comptent généralement plus que le résultat des urnes.

segments.src: ## What the historical pattern says
segments.tr: ## Ce que dit le schéma historique

segments.src: Market analysts have studied the four-year presidential cycle for decades.
segments.tr: Les analystes de marché étudient le cycle présidentiel de quatre ans depuis des décennies.

segments.src: Their most widely repeated finding is that the midterm year (the second year of a presidential term) has often been the weakest stretch of the cycle for U.S.
segments.tr: Leur constat le plus largement répété est que l'année de mi-mandat (la deuxième année d'un mandat présidentiel) a souvent été la période la plus faible du cycle pour les actions

segments.src: stocks.
segments.tr: américaines.

segments.src: Intra-year pullbacks have been common, and several midterm years have seen sizable declines at some point.
segments.tr: Les replis en cours d'année ont été fréquents, et plusieurs années de mi-mandat ont connu des baisses importantes à un moment donné.

segments.src: The stretch that follows has often looked better.
segments.tr: La période qui suit s'est souvent révélée meilleure.

segments.src: In many past cycles, the S&P 500 was higher 6 and 12 months after Election Day, and the period from the fourth quarter of a midterm year through the following year has frequently been among the stronger windows in the cycle.
segments.tr: Dans de nombreux cycles passés, le S&P 500 était plus élevé 6 et 12 mois après le jour du scrutin, et la période allant du quatrième trimestre d'une année de mi-mandat à l'année suivante a souvent compté parmi les fenêtres les plus fortes du cycle.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by source, by start date and by which years are included, so it is best to treat any single statistic with caution.
segments.tr: Les chiffres exacts varient selon la source, la date de début et les années incluses, il est donc préférable de traiter chaque statistique individuelle avec précaution.

segments.src: Some examples show how mixed the record is:
segments.tr: Quelques exemples montrent à quel point le bilan est mitigé :

segments.src: - **2002:** Stocks bottomed in October, shortly before the midterms, after a prolonged bear market. A recovery followed in 2003.
segments.tr: - **2002 :** Les actions ont touché un point bas en octobre, peu avant les élections de mi-mandat, après un marché baissier prolongé. Une reprise a suivi en 2003.

segments.src: - **2010:** Markets climbed through the fall and into 2011, helped by Federal Reserve support after the financial crisis.
segments.tr: - **2010 :** Les marchés ont grimpé tout au long de l'automne et jusqu'en 2011, soutenus par l'aide de la Réserve fédérale après la crise financière.

segments.src: - **2018:** A sharp late-year selloff ended around Christmas Eve. Stocks rebounded strongly in 2019 as the Fed paused its rate increases.
segments.tr: - **2018 :** Une forte vague de ventes en fin d'année s'est terminée vers la veille de Noël. Les actions ont fortement rebondi en 2019 lorsque la Fed a interrompu ses hausses de taux.

segments.src: - **2022:** The S&P 500 had a rough year as inflation and rate hikes weighed on valuations. The market bottomed in October, before the election, and recovered in 2023.
segments.tr: - **2022 :** Le S&P 500 a connu une année difficile, l'inflation et les hausses de taux ayant pesé sur les valorisations. Le marché a touché le fond en octobre, avant l'élection, puis s'est redressé en 2023.

segments.src: - **1994:** A surprise bond-market rout and a sharp round of Fed rate hikes left stocks largely flat, even though the political shift was dramatic.
segments.tr: - **1994 :** Une déroute surprise du marché obligataire et une série de hausses de taux marquées de la Fed ont laissé les actions quasiment stables, bien que le changement politique ait été spectaculaire.

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le « rallye post-mi-mandat » pourrait être moins causal qu'il n'y paraît

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.
segments.tr: Il existe plusieurs raisons de rester sceptique quant à une lecture trop poussée du calendrier.

segments.src: Uncertainty gets resolved.** Investors dislike not knowing.
segments.tr: L'incertitude se lève.** Les investisseurs n'aiment pas l'inconnu.

segments.src: Once the election is over, one source of unpredictability fades.
segments.tr: Une fois l'élection passée, une source d'imprévisibilité s'estompe.

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: Cela peut stimuler le sentiment, mais il s'agit d'un soulagement ponctuel, pas d'un moteur durable pour les rendements.

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: Le blocage politique n'est pas clairement haussier ou baissier.** Une idée reçue affirme qu'un gouvernement divisé est bon pour les actions car peu de lois sont votées.

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: Les preuves sont mitigées.

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: Les marchés ont bien et moins bien fonctionné sous de nombreuses combinaisons de contrôle partisan, et les résultats dépendent fortement de ce qui se passait par ailleurs dans l'économie.

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: L'échantillon est restreint.** Il n'y a eu qu'une douzaine d'élections de mi-mandat à l'ère moderne.

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: C'est un nombre d'observations trop faible pour séparer un effet réel d'une coïncidence, d'autant plus que chaque période avait sa propre récession, son propre cycle de taux ou son propre choc.

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: Le calendrier chevauche d'autres facteurs.** Les années de mi-mandat coïncident souvent avec la phase finale d'un cycle de resserrement de la Fed, un ralentissement économique ou une correction du marché.

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: Lorsque la correction prend fin et que les actions se redressent, il est tentant d'en attribuer le mérite à l'élection, alors qu'un changement dans les taux ou les perspectives de bénéfices a pu en être le véritable moteur.

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## Ce qui a tendance à compter davantage : les taux et les bénéfices

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: Sur le long terme, le cours des actions suit deux grandes forces : ce que gagnent les entreprises, et la manière dont les investisseurs valorisent ces bénéfices.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **Les taux d'intérêt.** Des taux plus élevés réduisent la valeur actuelle des profits futurs et augmentent les coûts d'emprunt pour les entreprises et les ménages. Lorsque la Fed cesse de relever ses taux ou commence à les baisser, les valorisations bénéficient souvent d'un soulagement. Plusieurs des meilleures périodes post-mi-mandat ont coïncidé avec des changements dans les perspectives de taux.

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.
segments.tr: - **Les bénéfices des entreprises.** En fin de compte, les actions ont besoin d'une croissance des profits pour continuer à monter. Les tendances des revenus, les marges et les prévisions des directions d'entreprises orientent généralement le marché bien plus que la couleur politique du Congrès.

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.
segments.tr: - **L'inflation et la croissance.** L'inflation affecte à la fois les taux et les coûts des entreprises, tandis que la croissance économique façonne la demande. Ensemble, elles définissent le contexte pour les bénéfices.

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.
segments.tr: - **Les valorisations et le point de départ.** Le niveau de départ du marché compte. Un rallye partant d'un niveau dépressif est différent d'un rallye qui commence alors que les prix sont déjà élevés.

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.
segments.tr: Les politiques publiques peuvent influencer ces facteurs, par exemple à travers les impôts, les tarifs douaniers, la réglementation et les dépenses publiques.

segments.src: But the effect usually plays out over years and depends on laws that actually pass, which is far from certain after any election.
segments.tr: Mais l'effet se produit généralement sur des années et dépend des lois qui sont réellement adoptées, ce qui est loin d'être certain après une élection.

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## Comment les investisseurs peuvent l'appréhender

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: Quelques enseignements pratiques découlent de l'histoire, sans qu'aucun ne constitue une prédiction :

segments.src: - **Treat seasonal patterns as context, not a signal.** A historical tendency can be interesting, but it is a weak basis for making large changes to a portfolio.
segments.tr: - **Considérez les schémas saisonniers comme un contexte, pas comme un signal.** Une tendance historique peut être intéressante, mais c'est une base très faible pour effectuer des modifications majeures dans un portefeuille.

segments.src: - **Watch the fundamentals.** The Fed's path, inflation data, and quarterly earnings reports are more direct clues to where markets may head.
segments.tr: - **Suivez les fondamentaux.** La trajectoire de la Fed, les données sur l'inflation et les résultats trimestriels sont des indices plus directs de l'orientation future des marchés.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Short-term moves around elections can be noisy and reverse quickly.
segments.tr: - **Évitez de réagir aux grandes manchette.** Les mouvements à court terme autour des élections peuvent être bruyants et s'inverser rapidement.

segments.src: - **Match decisions to your goals.** Time horizon, diversification and risk tolerance usually matter more than election timing.
segments.tr: - **Alignez vos décisions sur vos objectifs.** L'horizon temporel, la diversification et la tolérance au risque comptent généralement plus que le calendrier électoral.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: The idea of a post-midterm rally is not baseless.

pt.title: Ações e as eleições de meio de mandato: O que a história diz sobre os mercados após o dia da eleição, e o que ela não diz

segments.src: Every two years, a familiar line shows up in market commentary: stocks tend to rally after the midterm elections.
segments.tr: A cada dois anos, uma frase familiar aparece nos comentários de mercado: as ações tendem a subir após as eleições de meio de mandato.

segments.src: There is some truth in it.
segments.tr: Há alguma verdade nisso.

segments.src: But the pattern is a loose tendency, not a rule, and it can be easy to overstate.
segments.tr: Mas o padrão é uma tendência frouxa, não uma regra, e pode ser fácil exagerar.

segments.src: This article looks at what past cycles show, where the pattern comes from, and why interest rates and corporate earnings usually matter more than the ballot box.
segments.tr: Este artigo analisa o que os ciclos passados mostram, de onde vem o padrão e por que as taxas de juros e os lucros corporativos geralmente importam mais do que as urnas.

segments.src: ## What the historical pattern says
segments.tr: ## O que o padrão histórico diz

segments.src: Market analysts have studied the four-year presidential cycle for decades.
segments.tr: Analistas de mercado estudam o ciclo presidencial de quatro anos há décadas.

segments.src: Their most widely repeated finding is that the midterm year (the second year of a presidential term) has often been the weakest stretch of the cycle for U.S.
segments.tr: Sua descoberta mais repetida é que o ano de meio de mandato (o segundo ano de um mandato presidencial) tem sido frequentemente o período mais fraco do ciclo para as ações dos EUA.

segments.src: stocks.
segments.tr: ações.

segments.src: Intra-year pullbacks have been common, and several midterm years have seen sizable declines at some point.
segments.tr: Recuos dentro do ano têm sido comuns, e vários anos de meio de mandato viram quedas consideráveis em algum momento.

segments.src: The stretch that follows has often looked better.
segments.tr: O período que se segue tem parecido melhor.

segments.src: In many past cycles, the S&P 500 was higher 6 and 12 months after Election Day, and the period from the fourth quarter of a midterm year through the following year has frequently been among the stronger windows in the cycle.
segments.tr: Em muitos ciclos passados, o S&P 500 estava mais alto 6 e 12 meses após o dia da eleição, e o período do quarto trimestre de um ano de meio de mandato até o ano seguinte tem sido frequentemente uma das janelas mais fortes do ciclo.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by source, by start date and by which years are included, so it is best to treat any single statistic with caution.
segments.tr: Os números exatos variam de acordo com a fonte, a data de início e quais anos estão incluídos, por isso é melhor tratar qualquer estatística única com cautela.

segments.src: Some examples show how mixed the record is:
segments.tr: Alguns exemplos mostram quão misto é o histórico:

segments.src: - **2002:** Stocks bottomed in October, shortly before the midterms, after a prolonged bear market. A recovery followed in 2003.
segments.tr: - **2002:** As ações atingiram o fundo do poço em outubro, pouco antes das eleições de meio de mandato, após um mercado de baixa prolongado. Uma recuperação seguiu-se em 2003.

segments.src: - **2010:** Markets climbed through the fall and into 2011, helped by Federal Reserve support after the financial crisis.
segments.tr: - **2010:** Os mercados subiram durante o outono e até 2011, ajudados pelo apoio do Federal Reserve após a crise financeira.

segments.src: - **2018:** A sharp late-year selloff ended around Christmas Eve. Stocks rebounded strongly in 2019 as the Fed paused its rate increases.
segments.tr: - **2018:** Uma forte liquidação no final do ano terminou por volta da véspera de Natal. As ações se recuperaram fortemente em 2019, à medida que o Fed pausou seus aumentos de taxas.

segments.src: - **2022:** The S&P 500 had a rough year as inflation and rate hikes weighed on valuations. The market bottomed in October, before the election, and recovered in 2023.
segments.tr: - **2022:** O S&P 500 teve um ano difícil, pois a inflação e os aumentos das taxas pesaram nas avaliações. O mercado atingiu o fundo do poço em outubro, antes da eleição, e se recuperou em 2023.

segments.src: - **1994:** A surprise bond-market rout and a sharp round of Fed rate hikes left stocks largely flat, even though the political shift was dramatic.
segments.tr: - **1994:** Uma derrota surpresa no mercado de títulos e uma rodada acentuada de aumentos das taxas do Fed deixaram as ações praticamente estáveis, mesmo que a mudança política tenha sido dramática.

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks
segments.tr: ## Por que o "rali pós-meio de mandato" pode ser menos causal do que parece

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.
segments.tr: Existem algumas razões para ser cético quanto a ler demais no calendário.

segments.src: Uncertainty gets resolved.** Investors dislike not knowing.
segments.tr: A incerteza é resolvida.** Os investidores não gostam de não saber.

segments.src: Once the election is over, one source of unpredictability fades.
segments.tr: Uma vez que a eleição termina, uma fonte de imprevisibilidade desaparece.

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.
segments.tr: Isso pode elevar o sentimento, mas é um alívio único, não um motor duradouro para os retornos.

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: O impasse não é claramente de alta ou de baixa.** Uma alegação comum é que um governo dividido é bom para as ações porque pouca legislação é aprovada.

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.
segments.tr: As evidências são mistas.

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: Os mercados tiveram bom e mau desempenho sob muitas combinações de controle partidário, e os resultados dependem fortemente do que mais estava acontecendo na economia.

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: A amostra é pequena.** Houve apenas cerca de uma dúzia de eleições de meio de mandato na era moderna.

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: Isso é muito poucas observações para separar um efeito real da coincidência, especialmente quando cada período também teve sua própria recessão, ciclo de taxas ou choque.

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: O timing se sobrepõe a outras coisas.** Os anos de meio de mandato geralmente coincidem com o estágio final de um ciclo de aperto do Fed, uma economia em desaceleração ou uma correção de mercado.

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: Quando a correção termina e as ações se recuperam, é tentador creditar a eleição, quando uma mudança nas taxas ou nas expectativas de lucros pode ter feito o trabalho.

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## O que tende a importar mais: taxas e lucros

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: No longo prazo, os preços das ações seguem duas forças amplas: quanto as empresas lucram e como os investidores avaliam esses lucros.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. When the Fed stops raising rates, or begins cutting them, valuations often get relief. Several of the better post-midterm stretches lined up with changes in the rate outlook.
segments.tr: - **Taxas de juros.** Taxas mais altas tornam os lucros futuros menos valiosos em termos atuais e aumentam os custos de empréstimos para empresas e famílias. Quando o Fed para de aumentar as taxas, ou começa a cortá-las, as avaliações geralmente recebem alívio. Vários dos melhores períodos pós-meio de mandato alinharam-se com mudanças na perspectiva das taxas.

segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.
segments.tr: - **Lucros corporativos.** As ações precisam, em última análise, de crescimento de lucro para continuar subindo. As tendências de receita, margens e orientações futuras das gestões das empresas geralmente direcionam o mercado mais do que quem controla o Congresso.

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.
segments.tr: - **Inflação e crescimento.** A inflação afeta tanto as taxas quanto os custos das empresas, enquanto o crescimento econômico molda a demanda. Juntos, eles definem o cenário para os lucros.

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.
segments.tr: - **Avaliações e ponto de partida.** Onde o mercado começa importa. Um rali a partir de um nível deprimido é diferente de um que começa quando os preços já estão altos.

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.
segments.tr: A política pode influenciar esses fatores, por exemplo, por meio de impostos, tarifas, regulamentação e gastos do governo.

segments.src: But the effect usually plays out over years and depends on laws that actually pass, which is far from certain after any election.
segments.tr: Mas o efeito geralmente se desenrola ao longo de anos e depende de leis que realmente são aprovadas, o que está longe de ser certo após qualquer eleição.

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## Como os investidores podem pensar sobre isso

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: Algumas conclusões práticas seguem da história, nenhuma das quais é uma previsão:

segments.src: - **Treat seasonal patterns as context, not a signal.** A historical tendency can be interesting, but it is a weak basis for making large changes to a portfolio.
segments.tr: - **Trate os padrões sazonais como contexto, não como um sinal.** Uma tendência histórica pode ser interessante, mas é uma base fraca para fazer grandes mudanças em um portfólio.

segments.src: - **Watch the fundamentals.** The Fed's path, inflation data, and quarterly earnings reports are more direct clues to where markets may head.
segments.tr: - **Observe os fundamentos.** O caminho do Fed, os dados de inflação e os relatórios de lucros trimestrais são pistas mais diretas para onde os mercados podem ir.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Short-term moves around elections can be noisy and reverse quickly.
segments.tr: - **Evite reagir às manchetes.** Os movimentos de curto prazo em torno das eleições podem ser barulhentos e reverter rapidamente.

segments.src: - **Match decisions to your goals.** Time horizon, diversification and risk tolerance usually matter more than election timing.
segments.tr: - **Combine as decisões com seus objetivos.** O horizonte de tempo, a diversificação e a tolerância ao risco geralmente importam mais do que o timing eleitoral.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: The idea of a post-midterm rally is not baseless.
segments.tr: A ideia de um rali pós-meio de mandato não é infundada.

segments.src: Many past cycles saw stocks do well in the year after Election Day.
segments.tr: Muitos ciclos passados viram as ações terem um bom desempenho no ano após o dia da eleição.

segments.src: Still, the pattern has exceptions, the sample is small, and the causes are hard to pin on politics alone.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, o padrão tem exceções, a amostra é pequena e as causas são difíceis de atribuir apenas à política.

segments.src: For investors, the more reliable questions are about the trajectory of interest rates and the health of corporate profits.
segments.tr: Para os investidores, as questões mais confiáveis são sobre a trajetória das taxas de juros e a saúde dos lucros corporativos.

segments.src: The election may shape the mood, but those two factors have usually shaped the results.
segments.tr: A eleição pode moldar o humor, mas esses dois fatores geralmente moldaram os resultados.

segments.src: ## Why the "post-midterm rally" may be less causal than it looks

segments.src: There are a few reasons to be skeptical about reading too much into the calendar.

segments.src: That can lift sentiment, but it is a one-time relief, not a lasting engine for returns.

segments.src: Gridlock is not clearly bullish or bearish.** A common claim is that a divided government is good for stocks because little legislation passes.
segments.tr: Pemerintahan terpecah (gridlock) tidak secara jelas bersifat bullish atau bearish.** Klaim umum adalah bahwa pemerintah yang terbagi baik untuk saham karena sedikit undang-undang yang disahkan.

segments.src: The evidence is mixed.

segments.src: Markets have done well and poorly under many combinations of party control, and the results depend heavily on what else was happening in the economy.
segments.tr: Pasar telah berkinerja baik dan buruk di bawah banyak kombinasi kontrol partai, dan hasilnya sangat bergantung pada apa lagi yang terjadi di dalam perekonomian.

segments.src: The sample is small.** There have been only about a dozen or so midterm elections in the modern era.
segments.tr: Ukuran sampel kecil.** Hanya ada sekitar satu lusin pemilu sela di era modern.

segments.src: That is too few observations to separate a real effect from coincidence, especially when each period also had its own recession, rate cycle or shock.
segments.tr: Itu terlalu sedikit pengamatan untuk memisahkan efek nyata dari kebetulan, terutama ketika setiap periode juga memiliki resesi, siklus suku bunga, atau kejutan tersendiri.

segments.src: Timing overlaps with other things.** Midterm years often coincide with the late stage of a Fed tightening cycle, a slowing economy, or a market correction.
segments.tr: Waktu bertepatan dengan hal-hal lain.** Tahun pemilu sela sering kali bertepatan dengan tahap akhir dari siklus pengetatan Fed, perlambatan ekonomi, atau koreksi pasar.

segments.src: When the correction ends and stocks recover, it is tempting to credit the election, when a shift in rates or earnings expectations may have done the work.
segments.tr: Ketika koreksi berakhir dan saham pulih, sangat menggoda untuk mengaitkannya dengan pemilu, padahal pergeseran dalam suku bunga atau ekspektasi laba mungkin yang sebenarnya bekerja.

segments.src: ## What tends to matter more: rates and earnings
segments.tr: ## Apa yang cenderung lebih penting: suku bunga dan laba

segments.src: Over the long run, stock prices follow two broad forces: how much companies earn, and how investors value those earnings.
segments.tr: Dalam jangka panjang, harga saham mengikuti dua kekuatan besar: seberapa banyak keuntungan yang dihasilkan perusahaan, dan bagaimana investor menilai laba tersebut.

segments.src: - **Interest rates.** Higher rates make future profits worth less in today's terms and raise borrowing costs for companies and households. segments.src: - **Corporate earnings.** Stocks ultimately need profit growth to keep rising. Revenue trends, margins, and forward guidance from company managements typically drive the direction of the market more than who controls Congress.

segments.src: - **Inflation and growth.** Inflation affects both rates and company costs, while economic growth shapes demand. Together they set the backdrop for earnings.

segments.src: - **Valuations and starting point.** Where the market begins matters. A rally from a depressed level is different from one that begins when prices are already high.

segments.src: Policy can influence these factors, for instance through taxes, tariffs, regulation and government spending.

segments.src: ## How investors might think about it
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana investor dapat menyikapinya

segments.src: A few practical takeaways follow from the history, none of which is a prediction:
segments.tr: Beberapa kesimpulan praktis menyulut dari sejarah ini, tidak ada satupun yang merupakan prediksi:
